The error `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException: User not authenticated` was caused by `KeyGenParameterSpec` requiring user authentication (`setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`) in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L29) when generating the encryption key. Because the app does not perform biometric or credential authentication when the user taps "Sign in", Android Keystore prevented initializing the cipher.

### Changes Made

In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L26):
- Changed `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` to `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)`.
- Removed `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`.
